title: Enterprise Support: outcome precision and disposition for retained-fee cash return
content:
Enterprise Support — outcome precision and disposition for retained-fee cash return.

## Decision basis

For retained-fee cash return: A candidate at least minimum voluntary cash refund is rounded half up to cents; a smaller candidate remains on account and produces no refund authorization or financial write.

## Points of judgment

For retained-fee cash return: The minimum refund test precedes cent rounding. A candidate exactly at the applicable minimum qualifies; a smaller candidate remains on account without an authorization or financial entry.
